content:
The Austin Public Library is located in Austin, Minnesota. It is part of the Southeastern Libraries Cooperating (SELCO) library system. 

The library offers a wide range of services and resources to the community, including a large collection of books, eBooks, audiobooks, DVDs, and magazines for all ages. They also provide access to computers, printers, Wi-Fi, and meeting rooms.

Austin Public Library hosts various programs and events throughout the year, such as storytimes, book clubs, author visits, and workshops. They also offer a summer reading program for children and teens.

The library is located in a historic building that was originally constructed in 1901 and has undergone several renovations and expansions over the years to accommodate the growing needs of the community.

Overall, the Austin Public Library serves as a valuable resource and gathering place for the residents of Austin, providing access to information, education, and entertainment.
